svg.title: Noise and coherent spurs need different LO contracts
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: Noise and coherent spurs need different LO contracts
One −60 dBm blocker at the mixer input; noise allocation −162 dBm/Hz
A coherent LO sideband translates the blocker onto the wanted signal
Sη = 3e−11: reciprocal noise -164.9485 dBm/Hz; mask 6.3096e−11 rad²/Hz.
β = 0.0002 rad gives −80 dBc per sideband, yet about 0.721° retained bias.
The bias allocation instead requires β ≤ 5.5455e−6 rad (about −111.14 dBc).
The 10 MHz IF notch removes the original blocker, not this new 20 MHz component.
No universal L(f) conversion or measured synthesizer performance is assumed.
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
